name: baseline-management
description: Capture, compare, and release baselines of requirements / specs / artifacts over time. Supports named baselines tied to milestones (e.g., release v2.1, audit date, phase gate), diff between baselines (added / removed / changed items), impact metrics per diff, evidence preservation per baseline, and rollback protection. Essential for audit (ISO 13485, IEC 62304, aerospace, automotive) and change-control processes.
